description: Half-day session (3 h 30), remote or on site, for all staff and managers of an organisation, up to 25 people. Participants learn to spot an accessibility barrier and its effect on a user, apply basic practices to a link, an image and a common document, and write a useful issue report. No technical knowledge needed.
title: Sensibilisation des agents (Digital accessibility awareness for staff)
topics: Digital accessibility barriers, accessible links, images and documents
